internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Due to CPU Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 11:20 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service triggered a high latency alert. Diagnosis identified high CPU utilization as the root cause, linked to the recent enabling of the adHighCpu flag. The flag was disabled at 11:40 UTC, resulting in latency returning to normal levels. No memory leaks or error injections were found. The incident was resolved by disabling the flag, which alleviated the resource exhaustion issue.

Timeline:
- 11:20:25: Alert received for high latency
- 11:40:12: Diagnosis confirmed CPU resource exhaustion
- 11:40:17: Flag disabling proposed, approved, and executed
- 11:40:17: Latency verified to have normalized

Action Taken:
- Disabled the adHighCpu flag to reduce CPU load

Please monitor CPU utilization closely when enabling similar flags in the future.

external.body: Between 11:20 and 11:40 UTC on 2026-11-08, some users experienced increased latency in the ad service. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting system settings that were causing high CPU usage. Normal service performance has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
